'''Alouette''' (Japanese: '''アルメル''' ''Armelle'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|XY}}. She is a [[Pokémon Performer]].

==History==
Alouette first appeared in ''[[XY060|A Showcase Debut!]]'', where she competed in the [[Coumarine City]] [[Pokémon Showcase]]. She was first shown grooming her {{p|Furfrou}} in the preparing room for Pokémon Performers. She was then called onstage as one of the first three Pokémon Performers to perform in the first round, together with {{an|Shauna}} and [[Jessie|Jessilee]]. As part of the theme of the first round, "Pokémon Styling", she gave her Furfrou a [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Furfrou|Pharaoh Trim]]. It wasn't enough to proceed, however, as she didn't get enough votes from the audience, and thus fell slightly behind Shauna. Afterwards, she was shown talking with Shauna and congratulating her on her victory.

In ''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'', Alouette competed in the [[Fleurrh City]] Pokémon Showcase. Once again, she did not make it to the Freestyle Performance.

In ''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'', Alouette competed in the Master Class Pokémon Showcase in [[Gloire City]].

Furfrou participated with its Trainer in the [[Coumarine City]] [[Pokémon Showcase]]. It was first shown in the preparing room for Pokémon Performers, getting groomed by Alouette. Later, it participated in the first round, where it competed against {{an|Shauna}} and her {{TP|Shauna|Bulbasaur}} and [[Jessie|Jessilee]] and her {{TP|Jessie|Pumpkaboo}}. As part of the first round's theme, "Pokémon Styling", Alouette gave Furfrou a [[List of Pokémon with form differences#Furfrou|Pharaoh Trim]]. It wasn't enough to proceed, however, and Alouette and Furfrou were eliminated.

It reappeared in ''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'', where it competed alongside its Trainer in the [[Fleurrh City]] Pokémon Showcase. However, they were once again eliminated in the Theme Performance round.

Furfrou's only known move is {{m|Charge Beam}}.}}
